concept.hr: Raspodjela ili vruća pričuva, MCLT i partner down; stari podijeljeni opseg 80/20
concept.en: Load balance vs hot standby, MCLT and partner down; the old 80/20 split scope

summary.hr: Sruši DHCP1: DHCP2 obnavlja tuđe zakupe samo na MCLT, a partnerove adrese smije tek nakon PARTNER DOWN. Stari 80/20 nema zajedničku bazu.
summary.en: Fail DHCP1: DHCP2 renews the partner's leases for MCLT only and may use its addresses only after PARTNER DOWN. The old 80/20 shares nothing.
